author: Tobias Ellinghaus
name: check_for_updates
description: Checks GitHub for newer darktable releases on startup, at most once a week, and notifies the user when one is available.
description-extensive: This add-on quietly checks online whether a newer version of darktable has been released and lets you know if you are behind. It only looks once a week when the program starts, so it stays out of your way. This helps you keep your photo software up to date without having to check manually.
